chunks: 3159 - Al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام said to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله: “O my father, what is the reward of one who visits you?”

So the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: “O my son, whoever visits me while I am living or after my death, or visits your father, or visits your brother, or visits you, it is binding upon me that I visit him on the Day of Judgment and deliver him from his sins.”

key_terms.أُخَلِّصَهُ: I deliver him or free him
key_terms.جَزَاءُ: reward or recompense for an act
key_terms.مَيِّتًا: after death; in a state of death

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله and the Imams عليهم السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the immense reward for visiting the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام. It promises that such a visitor will receive the Prophet’s visitation on the Day of Judgment and be delivered from sins, highlighting the spiritual rank of these visits and their connection to salvation.
